base.description: Connected to the side of a cube

raised.description: Connected to the diagonal side of an edge (long edge of the edge shape laying diagonally vertical), but made for normally oriented cars

vertical diagonal.description: Rotated 45 degrees of the base variant

horizontal diagonal.description: Connected ot the diagonal side of an edge (long edge of the edge shape laying diagonally horizontal, made for cars that go forwards and left or forwards and right

tilted diagonal.description: Connected to the diagonal side of an edge (long edge of the edge shape laying diagonally vertical), different from raised

full diagonal.description: Connected to the diagonal triangular side of a tetra/inner, to support vehicles that move in all 3 diagonal ways, though i most likely will just make this an alternate of horizontal diagonal
